notes.title: Patch v0.1.6 and Roadmap Update
notes.notes:
Before starting this update, I want to thank everyone who has taken the time to download and play the game since its release last December. It has been an amazing experience talking and interacting with people, seeing them join our "play together" on the weekends, and helping make the game better with your feedback and suggestions. We really appreciate all the support received so far, so truly thank you from the bottom of our hearts!

One of the pieces of feedback we received the most was to add CPU-controlled bots to play it alone for practice or just fun. This makes total sense and it is something we really wanted to make since the beginning, but being a one-person dev team sadly limited what could be done without affecting the scope of the game and delaying other basic features that needed more time and attention. 

A roadmap was released mid-December mentioning the release of leaderboards in January, thinking it would be a nice way to attract more players. But after analyzing the current game's state, and evaluating what could give bigger benefits long term, we have decided to make [b]Bots[/b] the current highest priority instead of leaderboards and other features we considered less impactful, with work already started on the implementation of computer-controlled AI enemies inside the game. This we hope will give the game an extra leg to stand on its own and it will be an important foundation for new content to come in the future.    

Again thank you everybody for supporting THRILLKINGS over the past few months, and hopefully we will keep seeing you in the arena!


Now, to the changes on the new patch v0.1.6 released:


- Increased flamethrower damage and ammo capacity for Mech Suit
- Updated dismemberment performance on clients
- Updated strafe-jumping character movement code to use the latest UE5.4 character code changes
- Misc UI changes and performance fixes


Please verify your files to get the latest right away, and enjoy!

notes.title: Devlog #01
notes.notes:
Recently I got some feedback regarding the lack of social media presence before the game’s release, and how it can convey a sense that the game was rushed out or put together as a lazy asset flip. It made me feel sad given the amount of work I have poured into the game for the last 2 years, but it is also a fair point. There should be more sharing of the work-in-progress so people can see where we are coming from, which prompted me to write this blog.

This is an important lesson about marketing for any aspiring lone game developer out there: Share your work early, share it now, do not wait, no matter what it is, because people will love to see it grow and see your game development journey.

I am of the idea that all games deserve to exist no matter where the developers are coming from, but sadly sometimes those intentions are just to cash a quick buck and disappear into the forest, which can leave players jaded and doubtful when other projects show up and don’t meet certain standards.

Because of this, I want to start sharing more about Impulso Games, current and future projects in any phase of development, where do they coming from, and how far we want them to reach into the future. I wanted to share a tiny part of the THRILLKINGS journey, which in retrospect is crazy how long it has been since I created the project and loaded the editor for the first time.

Back in 2020, the game was originally going to be a Half-Life 2 mod on Unreal Engine 4, where the first task in my head was to recreate the OG Gravity Gun on UE, and be able to drive an Strider. No other purpose, no grandiose storyline, just those two things to see how far I could go. I made a post on a Source 2 discord channel and shared the first terrible run at this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303510/45eee55a51dfd229416f162c18cc2e941095d872.gif[/img]

It was awful, and it was fun! But of course, Valve’s classic gameplay is always fun, just grabbing and throwing stuff is a timeless good time, just go and ask Garry from GMOD. The big question was, how can I make the Strider drivable?

I started testing a grappling hook, which went nowhere, lots of very big games were doing it way more effectively by then and I felt I was already scoping this beyond my skillset. I played around and tried to do some smaller stuff, but got frustrated, grabbed the project, and shelved it for almost 2 years…

Fast forward to 2022, I moved countries and other things happened in the meantime, and while in my new home looking for a new job, I started thinking about some game projects to start getting back into game development, and this old project popped up back into my head.

I loaded it up again motivated by the recent release of Unreal Engine 5.0, and while jumping around and thinking of ways to get on top of the Strider, I wondered if I could propel myself with the gravity gun, like a harmless rocket jump… and it clicked. Infinitely pushing yourself around the map became too much fun to let go. I retook the project, properly configured Unreal Engine 5.0, and made the start of the first repository for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303510/355ddd70e151aa42d28628bc60c4dc585120ba26.png[/img]

I didn’t take it too seriously while I was juggling with other responsibilities, but the game started to go in full swing by the end of 2023. I managed to make the Strider drivable and react to the map with IK legs (I will capture footage of this if somebody is interested, need to set up that previous UE version!). The problem with something like this is that Valve owns the property, and sadly had to remove it from the game after some time. But the idea of driving monsters around the map stuck with me, and the idea of “Thrills” was born. A velociraptor and a Mech were the obvious ones to implement, and from there the game continued growing as a mix of Half-Life 2: Deathmatch and Unreal Tournament to what it is today.

Replication and multiplayer are a hell of a beast for a solo developer with big ambitions, but I knew deep inside this was what I wanted to do 100%, and with the support of my family I went full steam ahead on what some would call “production”, on January 2024. It is now December 2024, the game has been out for 2 weeks, and we are on a high that feels incredible. So many ideas are coming to the whiteboard, and we want to keep updating everything in the game and just see people have a great time when playing with it.

There have been a lot of things happening since the game was released and I cannot wait to share them with everybody. I feel so fulfilled and grateful for the kind words that people have shared with me, and I am excited to give a glimpse of what is to come for the next 3 months:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303510/f2f109d54824dfd6705599936245c6b93b728e0c.png[/img]

This is just the start of many updates and other games to come, and I hope everybody who gives us a chance joins us on this grand adventure.

–

One last thing I want to share on a more personal note. My family lives in another country thousands of miles away from me, and sadly I can’t see my nephews in person as much as I wish I could. My oldest nephew loves video games, and playing online is a way to stay connected and talk with him every week. I am always looking for video games to play together, like Doom, Nioh, or Monster Hunter. And watching him enjoy himself while testing the game is what made me decide to publish the game this month. To be able to play with him and his friends, having a blast while slowly seeing progress every month, meant the world to me. I don’t know if only 1 or 10 people will ever like the game, but listening to him laugh every time he one-shots from the other side of the map and asking me if I am available to play after school is, to be honest, all the joy I could ever ask for.

notes.title: Play Together: Every Friday 9 P.M. EST
notes.notes:
The team wants to invite everybody to play some matches, and have some fun with others that are playing the game for the first time! We want to do this a weekly occurrence during Early Access launch, every Friday at 9 P.M. EST for the next month.

We also have a Discord for organizing community matches, so please join us there to meet other players, report any issues, and talk about future updates and features that would like to see!

Discord Invite: [url=https://discord.com/invite/CxZe4nuRp7]https://discord.com/invite/CxZe4nuRp7[/url]

See you in the Arena!

notes.title: Early Access Launch Date: Dec. 5th 9PM EST
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=GTUyAJdU7iw;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally we are proud to share the news, the game will officially release on December 5th, 9 PM EST, on Steam Early Access for free to everybody on the platform!

It has been a long journey, and the past year has brought us a lot of joy and excitement, and we can not wait for everybody to finally put their hands on the game and share with us their thoughts, feedback, and all the ideas that can make the game and future content even better.

Thank you for all the support, and see you in the arena!
